## Recipe Fields

Each recipe states:

- Purpose
- Inputs
- Outputs
- Tailoring
- Validation check
- Authority boundary
- PMBOK source section

The recipe describes a useful technical way of working. It is not a mandatory methodology. Project-specific tailoring recorded in Stage 01 controls the run.
